root_idea.summary: The root centers on remaining or lingering at a point, with related extensions involving standing, stopping, or fixed placement.
root_idea.development: From physical standing or staying, the lexicon develops uses for pausing, attending, being brought before something, informing, mutual standing, and things fixed or dedicated in place.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized from the internal QAC lemma to the Classical Arabic Form I citation headword وَقَفَ.
Presented under the singular passive-participle citation form مَوْقُوفٌ rather than the Quranic plural مَوْقُوفُونَ.

senses.definition: To stop, hold stationary, or stand still.
senses.usage_conditions: The active imperative is transitive in وَقِفُوهُمْ, “make them stop” or “hold them back”; passive forms express being made to stand. Voice and construction determine whether the subject stops or is caused to stop.

senses.definition: To be brought before something and made to see or know what is in it; to be confronted with it.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially associated with the passive construction وَقِفَ عَلَيْهِ. In the Quran-attested usage, the expression can convey presentation or confrontation with something, not merely physical halting.

senses.definition: One who is made to stand or brought before something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the masculine plural مَوْقُوفُونَ and describes people being made to stand or brought before an object of confrontation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pause at a thing and give it attention.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى for pausing at and attending to something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To comprehend a meaning; to understand it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of وَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ with a meaning as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come upon or meet a word or the like while reading.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of encountering a word or comparable expression during reading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquaint someone with a crime, fault, or similar matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction وَقَفْتُهُ عَلَى ذَنْبِهِ means that the person was informed of or made acquainted with the offense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withstand or resist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use governs by عَنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make property an inalienable endowment, or to give it as an unalienable legacy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive verbal use is also reported as rare or disapproved; the related noun وَقْفٌ denotes the endowment itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone pause or wait at a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II construction, commonly used with عَلَى for the matter at which someone is made to wait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To teach the places at which one should pause in recitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of instructing someone in the stopping points of reading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquaint, inform, or reveal a thing to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction وَقَّفَهُ عَلَى الشَّيْءِ conveys making someone acquainted with or informed of the thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To explain or clarify a tradition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a tradition or report as the object of explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand with another in competition or act as a partner in a match.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or competitive construction involving standing alongside another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquaint someone with a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction أَوْقَفَهُ عَلَى conveys informing or making someone acquainted with the matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pause or wait at a matter; by extension, to restrict oneself to what has been heard and not go beyond it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The latter restriction is used of adhering to established transmitted usage, especially in linguistic matters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hesitate or deliberate about a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with فِي for hesitation or deliberation concerning something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain or abstain from a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ for holding back from or abstaining from something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To depend on, rest on, or be grounded in something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى of an opinion, judgment, proof, inquiry, or result whose validity or occurrence depends on something else.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inalienable endowment, legacy, or gift; a mortmain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal legal and property use for something dedicated so that it is not alienated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The halting or stationing of pilgrims at ʿArafāt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for the pilgrims’ ritual halt at the designated place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ivory bracelet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal object-name associated with something fixed around its place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having white markings at the fetlocks, like an ivory bracelet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said specifically of a donkey whose fetlocks bear this pattern of white.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where a person or other thing stands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-noun referring to the location of standing or stationing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mutual standing with another in a competition or match.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal relation in which each party takes a position in relation to the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild animal forced by a hunter to stand until it can be caught.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of game brought to a standstill or trapped in a position from which it cannot escape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression حَبِطَ مَوْقِفُ الفَرَسِ, the horse’s belly became inflated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical or idiomatic equine use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Brought to the verge of infidelity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression مَوْقُوفٌ عَلَى حَدِّ كُفْرٍ for being brought to the limit or brink of disbelief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hesitant and withholding a decided opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes someone who does not adopt or issue a firm judgment concerning the matter.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Standing still and remaining stationary are covered by the Form I stopping sense.
Making a beast stationary is a causative instance of stopping.
Stopping or pausing at someone or something is covered by the stopping sense.
The attention-oriented construction is separately represented.
Comprehending a meaning is separately represented.
Encountering a word in reading is separately represented.
The Quran-linked passive confrontation or being-made-to-stand use is represented on both relevant public forms.
Making someone acquainted with a fault is separately represented.
The resist or withstand construction is separately represented.
The reported inalienable-giving verbal use is represented.
The Form II causative waiting construction is represented.
Both teaching recitation stops and the related making-known use are represented.
Acquainting, informing, or revealing is represented.
Explaining a tradition is represented.
A pointer to a legal term without a definition.
Pointer-only cross-reference.
Competitive or reciprocal standing is represented in verbal and nominal wording.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry.
The Form IV acquainting construction is represented.
The crime-related construction is covered by the same Form IV acquainting meaning.
Pausing, waiting, and restricting oneself to transmitted usage are represented.
Hesitation or deliberation is separately represented.
Refraining or abstaining is separately represented.
Dependence or being grounded in something is separately represented.
The noun’s endowment meaning is represented.
The conventional expression for halting at ʿArafāt is represented.
The specialized equine anatomical use is represented.
The idiom for being brought to the verge of infidelity is represented.
The adjective for withholding a decided opinion is represented.

cautions: The normalized Form I headword covers both the active imperative in 37:24 and passive occurrences in 6:27 and 6:30; voice and construction account for their differing English realizations.
The Quranic passive participle is presented in singular citation form مَوْقُوفٌ although its supplied Quran occurrence is the plural مَوْقُوفُونَ.
The endowment meaning is distinct from physical standing and is reported both as an established noun and as a rare or disapproved transitive verbal usage.
